transition.intent: Advance only after the external account, hosting, storage, publish, secret, and public-data plan has explicit owner approval.
transition.validation_command: cd Front-End && npm run deps:ci && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run typecheck && cd ../Back-End && ./scripts/verify.sh core && ./scripts/verify.sh websocket
transition.transition_validation_command: cd Front-End && npm run deps:ci && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run typecheck && cd ../Back-End && ./scripts/verify.sh core && ./scripts/verify.sh websocket
transition.decision_rule: Do not move to maintenance-only, provision accounts, deploy, create secrets, or publish public data until owner approval is recorded.

phase_model.purpose: Validate the local collaborative editor, REST API, WebSocket sync, document credentials, and snapshot store boundaries.
exit_criteria: frontend build, lint, test, and typecheck pass
backend core and websocket verification pass

phase_model.purpose: Manually review any external storage, hosting, account, or publish requirements.
Keep the editor buildable and documented when no development scope is selected.
blocked_work: new external integrations without explicit request
exit_criteria: a new collaborative-editor feature scope is selected

required_gates.description: Frontend build, lint, tests, and typecheck pass.
evidence: cd Front-End && npm run deps:ci && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run typecheck

required_gates.description: Backend core and WebSocket verification pass.
Frontend and backend checklist evidence is current for local collaborative-editor validation.

required_gates.description: External account, storage, hosting, publish, secret, and public-data needs are listed for local-validation exit. Explicit owner approval is still required in the next phase before provisioning, deployment, or secret creation.

required_gates.description: The owner must explicitly approve the external account, hosting, storage, publish, secret, and public-data plan before this project leaves external provisioning review.
required_gates.on_failure: Stay in external-account-provisioning-review; do not provision external accounts, deploy, create secrets, or publish public data.
